**Finding: Compliant** — no redline required.

- **Our convenience right:** § 9.4 lets us terminate the Agreement or any Order Form without cause, with the notice period fixed at thirty days by § 29.4 — the preferred position.
- **No penalty:** we owe only accrued Fees and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (§ 9.4, reinforced by § 10.2). No early-termination fee exists anywhere in the document, and § 7.1 blocks unidentified minimum-use style charges.
- **Vendor cannot walk away:** Vendor's rights are limited to material breach (§ 9.1), insolvency (§ 9.2), and the narrow IP-remedy carve-out in § 20 (which expressly forbids terminating unaffected Services). There is no Vendor convenience right during the three-year term (§ 8.1) or at renewal, and non-renewal under § 8.2 is Customer-controlled.
- **Noted but out of scope:** § 7.7's fifteen-percent-per-week late-payment liquidated damages is a payment-default provision rather than a termination penalty, so it does not affect this rule — though it may warrant attention under the payment/interest rule.
